title: Three equal columns
summary: Equal widths, whatever the content, filling the container.
brief: Put the three columns side by side, filling .cols from edge to edge, 16px apart.
They must be exactly the same width even though their text differs.
hints: Columns sized by their content will not be equal. You need the container to share the space out.
With grid: three 1fr tracks. With flex: flex: 1 on each column.
display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); gap: 16px on .cols.

children.text: Two has a little more text in it

solutionNotes: 1fr tracks share the space left after gaps equally. The flex equivalent is flex: 1 (a flex-basis of 0), so content length does not affect the share.
